about: Short sessions at other rates and edge cases of SHARING_40.md 19.4: each input as test_signal or the formula named, the session encoded and muxed with the serial and vendor given, and the whole output (the segments concatenated) by size, SHA-256 and, when small, in full. `segments` is the number of frames in each segment.

cases.name: r44100_1s5
cases.what: a 44.1 kHz session in one segment: 16 full frames and a last frame of 614 samples (block size code 7, 16 bits)

cases.name: r11025_0s5
cases.what: a rate without a code that is not a multiple of 10: the rate in Hz as 16 bits (code 13)

cases.name: r12000_1s
cases.what: a rate that is a multiple of 1000: the rate in kHz as 8 bits (code 12)

cases.name: r22050_full
cases.what: two full frames: the end of the stream on a frame of 4096 samples

cases.name: r8000_3
cases.what: three samples: one verbatim frame (a block of 4 samples or fewer is never predicted), block size code 6

cases.name: r32000_200
cases.what: one block of 200 samples: the Rice partition order is limited by its trailing zero bits (3)

cases.name: r50000_odd
cases.what: a 50 kHz rate (code 12) and a last block of 3 samples after a verbatim frame

cases.name: r88200_wasted
cases.what: every sample a multiple of 4 (two wasted bits): a ramp, then a constant

cases.name: r24000_extremes
cases.what: full scale square waves and alternation: frames at the 16-bit limits
